introHtml: Travel size keychains with carabiner combine compact portability with a secure attachment clip, making them ideal for trade shows, safety giveaways, or event swag. Unlike standard keychains, these clip onto bags, belts, or lanyards for easy access. Decorate with your logo via pad printing or engraving to keep your brand visible wherever recipients go.
